title: One-shot identification of analytic systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.30470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study when the coefficients of a linearly parameterized analytic system can be identified from a single input-solution pair. Given a finite dictionary of analytic operators, each admissible input induces a finite-dimensional linear recovery map from coefficients to observed outputs. Coefficient recovery is possible exactly when this map is injective. We define the degenerate input set as the set of inputs for which injectivity fails and prove a zero-one law: either every admissible input is degenerate, or the degenerate set is negligible in the sense that it is compactly slice-null and has zero measure under every nondegenerate Gaussian measure. We then apply this framework to the recovery of matrices, analytic continuous-time dynamical systems, and differential operators. For several ODE and PDE classes, we further characterize the degenerate sets explicitly and identify deterministic choices of inputs that guarantee recovery.

translated_abstract: 我们研究线性参数化解析系统的系数何时能够从单个输入-解对中被识别出来。给定一个由解析算子构成的有限字典，每个容许输入都会诱导一个从系数到观测输出的有限维线性恢复映射，且当且仅当该映射是单射时，系数恢复才是可能的。我们定义了退化输入集，即单射性失效的输入集合，并证明了一个零一律：要么所有容许输入都是退化的，要么退化集是可忽略的——即它是紧切片零测的，并且在每一个非退化高斯测度下测度为零。随后我们将该框架应用于矩阵、解析连续时间动力系统以及微分算子的恢复问题。对于若干常微分方程（ODE）和偏微分方程（PDE）类别，我们进一步显式刻画了退化集，并识别出能够保证恢复的确定性输入选择。
tldr: 该论文建立了解析系统系数从单次输入-解对中被识别的通用理论，证明了退化输入集满足零一律，并将其应用于矩阵、动力系统与微分算子的恢复，为多类ODE和PDE给出了显式的退化集刻画及保证恢复的确定性输入。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a general theory for identifying coefficients of analytic systems from a single input-solution pair, proves a zero-one law for the degenerate input set, applies the framework to recovery of matrices, dynamical systems, and differential operators, and explicitly characterizes degenerate sets with deterministic inputs guaranteeing recovery for several ODE and PDE classes.
